messages.subject: Saving plots on shiny server
parts:
I am working on a shiny app in which I am trying to save a map and plotly plot as jpeg images as part of a download. This works perfectly when I run the app/download locally in RStudio, however when I push the code to the shiny server, the download fails.

The code to save the map and plotly plot as jpeg files is below:
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(mapData(), "temp.html", selfcontained = FALSE)
webshot("temp.html", "map.jpeg", cliprect = "viewport")
    
plotly::export(p1(), file = "plotly.jpeg")

Here mapData() returns a leaflet object and p1() returns the plotly object.

The log file gives the below error:
Warning in dir.create(outputDir) :
  cannot create dir 'temp_files', reason 'Permission denied'
Warning in dir.create(target_dir) :
  cannot create dir 'temp_files/htmlwidgets-0.9', reason 'No such file or directory'
Warning in dir.create(dirname(to), recursive = TRUE) :
  cannot create dir 'temp_files', reason 'Permission denied'
Warning in file.create(to[okay]) :
  cannot create file 'temp_files/htmlwidgets-0.9/htmlwidgets.js', reason 'No such file or directory'
Error in normalizePath(target_dir, "/", TRUE) : 
  path[1]="temp_files/htmlwidgets-0.9": No such file or directory


I am not sure where the temp directory 'temp_files' will be created. I manually created 'temp_files' directory at every level.
/home 
/srv/shiny-server/
/srv/shiny-server/appfolder/

and changed owner to 'shiny'. This still does not help. Any help on what needs to be done to allow saving files on shiny server?
